notes.title: Update 1.1 Pussycat Feast!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1968110/Neko_Girls_Hentai_Jigsaw_Photo_Studio/][img]https://i.imgur.com/OJmJrGU.jpg[/img][/url]

Who wants more [b]Neko Girls[/b]??? In this update we present you with the delicious [b]Pussycat Feast[/b]! Every single [b]Neko Girl[/b] got a new color and a wet 4th Level. We also improved the UI in many places and corrected a lot of bugs. Between September 19th and 26th you can grab [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1968110/Neko_Girls_Hentai_Jigsaw_Photo_Studio/]the game[/url][/b] with 10% OFF or, even cheaper, if you get the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/21384/CUMplete_Pack/]CUMplete Pack[/url][/b] with all the games from the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/40369341]Hentai Jigsaw Photo Studio[/url][/b] series.

Until September 26th all [b]Tabbu Entertainment[/b] Games are with great discounts. Check them below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1968110/Neko_Girls_Hentai_Jigsaw_Photo_Studio/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1812890/Fruit_Girls_2_Hentai_Jigsaw_Photo_Studio/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1504460/Fruit_Girls_Hentai_Jigsaw_Photo_Studio/

Below is the complete changelog:

[b][u]ART[/u][/b]
[list][*]We added 4 new artworks to each [b]Neko Girl[/b] and 4 to the [b]Pussycat Gang[/b], totalizing 24 new artworks! You will unlock them by playing the [b]Levels[/b] in the [b]Photobook[/b].[/list]

[b][u]PUZZLE[/u][/b]
[list][*]To each new artwork, we have a new [b]Level[/b] in the game! So, we have 24 new [b]Levels[/b] in total! You can access them in the [b]Photobook[/b].
[*]We removed the transparent effect used in the puzzle pieces.[/list]

[b][u]PHOTOBOOK[/u][/b]
[list][*]We implemented the 24 [b]Pussycat Feast Levels[/b] in the [b]Photobook[/b].
[*]We also added cute cats in the [b]Pussycat Feast[/b] pages of the [b]Photobook[/b].[/list]

[b][u]DARKROOM[/u][/b]
[list][*]We implemented a [b]Film Button[/b] to cycle through the artworks from the base game and the ones from the [b]Pussycat Feast[/b].[/list]

[b][u]QUALITY OF LIFE[/u][/b]
[list][*]Now you can navigate in the [b]Photobook[/b] and in the [b]Darkroom[/b] using [b]A[/b] or [b]<[/b] to go Left and [b]D[/b] or [b]>[/b] to go Right.[/list]

[b][u]ACHIEVEMENTS[/u][/b]
[list][*]We had to rework several Achievs to suit Steam's policies.
[*]We also added the Achievs related to the new [b]Puzzles[/b] but old owners will have almost all of them already unlocked due to how we implemented them.[/list]

[b][u]THE HANDJOB ARTIFICER ART PACK[/u][/b]
[list][*]We added 37 artworks to the pack. It now contains 117 files![/list]

Remember that our [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/21384/CUMplete_Pack/]CUMplete Pack[/url][/b] contains the new game, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1968110/Hentai_Jigsaw_Photo_Studio_Neko_Girls/]Neko Girls: HJPS[/url][/b], the new art pack [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1970351/Neko_Girls_The_Handjob_Artificer_Art_Pack/]Neko Girls: The Handjob Artificer Art Pack[/url][/b], the new soundtrack [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1970330/Neko_Girls_The_Horny_Bard_Soundtrack/]Neko Girls: The Horny Bard Soundtrack[/url][/b] and everything from the second game, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1812890/Hentai_Jigsaw_Photo_Studio_Fruit_Girls_2/]Fruit Girls 2: HJPS[/url][/b], and from the first game, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1504460/Hentai_Jigsaw_Photo_Studio_Fruit_Girls/]Fruit Girls: HJPS[/url][/b]. All of it with a permanent [b]20% discount[/b] that stacks with any sale discount!
